I called this because Alice is dead in lower_engine. My route was upper_engine → lower_engine → storage → medbay → electrical → cafeteria → weapons → security → navigation → security → weapons → cafeteria.

I saw Alice alive in medbay around ticks 12-13. Diana entered medbay from upper_engine around tick 11, so Diana was near Alice early, but that’s not enough by itself. Later I saw Charlie in weapons around 23-24 and security at 32. Diana was in weapons/security a lot later too, around 23, 25, 32-36. Eve was around security/weapons at 34-35. Bob was in weapons around 35-36 and came into cafeteria from weapons at 38, right near me.

Body is lower_engine, so whoever killed Alice probably had access through upper_engine or storage. I don’t have a hard accusation yet, but Alice being alive in medbay with Diana nearby earlier is the main thing I can offer.

My route was navigation → storage → lower_engine → upper_engine → medbay → electrical → cafeteria → weapons/security area.

I was in storage around tick 8 and saw Frank come in from lower_engine. Then I went to lower_engine around ticks 12-13 and saw Charlie there. I did not see Alice or a body in lower_engine at that time, so if Frank is right that Alice was alive in medbay around then, she died after that.

Later I was mostly on the right side: I saw Charlie in security around 31, Frank in security/weapons around 33-35, Diana in security/weapons around 33-36, and Eve in weapons around 35. Frank left weapons to cafeteria at 36, and I came into cafeteria from weapons at 38.

Main useful thing from me: Charlie was in lower_engine early, but Alice apparently wasn’t dead there yet. I didn’t see Alice at all this round. I don’t have a hard accuse, but the lower_engine/medbay timing makes me want to hear from Charlie and Diana especially.

I can add timing: I saw Alice moving storage into lower_engine around 20-22, so she was definitely alive after the medbay sighting. I didn’t see a body then, just her going that way. After that I was mostly moving back toward right side and I ran into Bob/Diana/Frank around security/weapons in the 30s.

That makes the kill window after Alice went lower, probably between 22 and Frank calling. I agree Charlie and Diana are the main people I want to hear from, but Charlie especially because Bob placed Charlie in lower_engine earlier and I later saw Charlie leaving security toward weapons around 30, which could fit moving away from left side. Not hard accusing yet, but Charlie’s route matters a lot here.

My route was oxygen → upper_engine → lower_engine → storage → medbay → electrical → security/weapons area, then briefly back electrical/medbay/cafeteria/weapons.

Important timing: Bob saw me in lower_engine around tick 13, and I also saw Bob enter from storage then. I did not see Alice or a body there. After that I left lower_engine through storage and was on the medbay/electrical/right side. By the time Eve says Alice went storage → lower_engine around 20-22, I was not on that side anymore.

I never saw Alice this round. I did see Diana move from lower_engine to upper_engine very early, then later Diana was around electrical/security/weapons a lot. I saw Bob and Eve in security around 30, Frank came in from navigation around 32, and Diana/Bob/Frank were all around security/weapons after that.

So from my view, the kill has to be after Bob and I were in lower_engine with no body, and after Eve saw Alice going lower. That makes the window later than tick 20. I don’t think Bob’s sighting on me is incriminating because Alice wasn’t dead yet. I want to hear Diana’s exact route, because she was the other person around left side early, but I’m also not clearing Eve completely since she’s the one who places Alice going into lower_engine later.

My route was lower_engine → upper_engine → medbay → electrical → then I stayed basically on the right side cycling security/weapons.

I saw Alice alive in medbay ticks 12-14. Frank was also around medbay then and left medbay to electrical at 13, then I saw him leave electrical toward cafeteria at 17. After that I did not go back to lower_engine or storage at all.

Later on the right side: I saw Charlie in weapons/security around 25, 29, 30; Eve came into security from electrical at 30; Bob and Frank were in security around 33-34; Eve again came in from navigation at 34; Bob and Frank were in weapons around 36.

So if Eve’s info is true that Alice went storage → lower_engine around 20-22, then that clears the early medbay suspicion on me, because Alice was alive after I had already gone right side. The person closest to that claimed timing is actually Eve, since she says she saw Alice heading into lower_engine and then later appears in security from electrical at 30, which is a possible path away from lower/storage. I’m not saying it’s 100%, but Eve’s story is the one that places Alice at the death location and only Eve saw that. I’m most suspicious of Eve right now, unless someone can confirm where she was immediately after 22.

Now that everyone’s talked, Eve is my strongest suspicion.

If Eve’s sighting is true, Alice went storage → lower_engine around 20-22, and Eve is the only person placing herself right there at the death location in the real kill window. Eve then shows up on the right side from electrical/security around 30, which is a plausible route away from lower_engine through storage/medbay/electrical.

Charlie being in weapons by 23-24 makes it pretty hard for him to have killed Alice in lower_engine after Eve’s claimed sighting, unless the timing is way off. Diana’s early medbay timing looks less suspicious if Alice was alive later. Bob also says lower_engine was clear around 12-13.

So either Eve is telling the truth and had the best opportunity, or Eve invented that sighting to shape the timeline. Either way, I’m leaning Eve.

I’m still leaning Eve after hearing everyone.

My lower_engine timing was tick 12-13: I saw Charlie there, no Alice and no body. So Charlie being there early doesn’t mean much unless the timing is wrong.

If Eve really saw Alice go storage to lower_engine around 20-22, that’s the real kill window. Eve is the only one who places herself near Alice at that exact time, and then I saw Eve later coming into security from navigation and going weapons around 34-35. That route could fit leaving the lower/storage side and ending up right side later.

Diana and Frank were both mostly right side later, and Charlie was also on the right by security/weapons later. Not hard cleared, but Eve has the most direct opportunity based on the info we have. I’m probably voting Eve unless someone has a stronger contradiction.

I get why my sighting makes me look close to it, but I want to point out I’m the one who volunteered that Alice was alive going into lower_engine. If I killed her there, inventing the exact timing that puts me near her would be a pretty terrible cover.

My actual path after that was lower_engine → upper_engine → medbay → electrical → security, and I got to security around 30 where Bob/Diana were, and I saw Charlie leaving security toward weapons. So yes, I was on that side earlier, but I didn’t stay there.

The thing bothering me is Frank’s confidence on the body location from an emergency meeting. He says Alice is dead in lower_engine, but his route doesn’t have him finding/reporting it, and he’s using that info to steer the vote onto me. If Frank actually saw the body, why emergency instead of report? If he didn’t see it, how is he so sure?

I’m not saying hard Frank, but the push on me feels way too clean for someone with “no hard accusation.” I still think Charlie/Frank timing needs more scrutiny, and I don’t think voting me here is good.

I want to revisit Eve’s point because it’s actually important: Frank called an emergency, not a report, but he opened with “Alice is dead in lower_engine.” I don’t understand how he knows the body location unless he personally saw it and didn’t report, or unless he killed there.

My observed timing: I saw Eve enter security from electrical at tick 30, Bob from weapons at 30, Frank from navigation at 32, Diana moving security/weapons around 31-32. That does fit Eve being able to come from left side, yes — but it also means Frank’s certainty about lower_engine is unexplained.

Based on routes, Eve had opportunity if her Alice sighting is true. But Frank knowing the location from an emergency is a bigger contradiction to me. If Frank can’t explain how he knew lower_engine, I’m much more suspicious of Frank than Eve right now.

I agree with Charlie’s last point — Frank’s certainty is the biggest problem now.

My route again was lower_engine → upper_engine → medbay → electrical → then I stayed right side security/weapons almost the whole rest of the round. I saw Alice alive in medbay ticks 12-14. I also saw Frank leave medbay to electrical at 13 and leave electrical toward cafeteria at 17. After that I never went back left.

Eve definitely had opportunity if her sighting is true: she says Alice went storage → lower_engine around 20-22, and then Eve shows up in security from electrical at 30. That path is possible.

But Frank opened the meeting saying Alice is dead in lower_engine, even though this was an emergency call, not a report. If he saw the body, why didn’t he report it? If he didn’t see the body, how does he know the location? That’s a much clearer contradiction than just “Eve was nearby.”

Also Frank was in lower_engine very early — I saw him enter lower_engine from upper_engine at tick 3 — and his whole story is built around steering us to Eve after claiming exact body location. I’m more suspicious of Frank now than Eve. Unless there’s some mechanic I’m missing that told Frank the body location, I think Frank is the better vote.

The body was in cafeteria. I reported immediately because Charlie was literally right there coming in from weapons at the same time, and Diana’s body was on the floor.

I can confirm my earlier point: at tick 44 I saw Diana and Eve enter weapons from security together. I did not see Charlie come in with them at that moment.

I’m leaning Eve because I personally saw Eve with Diana at the latest point, and the first report had no info until pushed. But I want to be clear: the deciding issue is whether Charlie was actually in cafeteria. I never saw Charlie there.

I’m going to be very clear: my logged route was security → weapons → security → navigation → security → weapons. I did not have a cafeteria route this round before the report.

What I personally saw is Diana and Eve together coming from weapons into security at tick 41. Bob also independently says he saw Eve with Diana later around weapons/security and did not see me with them. Eve only gave the cafeteria location after being pushed, and now her whole defense is “Charlie was there,” which directly conflicts with my route and with Bob not seeing me around that pair.

At 3 alive, from my POV it can only be Eve or Bob. Bob’s info has matched mine twice, and Eve was the last person repeatedly seen with Diana, then reported with no initial details. I still think this is Eve self-reporting and trying to flip it on me.
